statement: For the exact two-point pushing kernel J in the common-involution eight-puncture sphere, the full two-track quotient is Fhat5 times Fhat5 and its kernel is the actual B=K0 intersect K2 of F14. The specified involution has a single Jhat-conjugacy class of sections. Its full fixed subgroup is the specified Fhat7 from the fixed-configuration double cover; its projection is the graph of the filling epimorphism Fhat7 to Fhat5. Every B-valued involution cocycle is a B-coboundary, with the exact left-coset parametrization by C_B(R). The fixed quotient sequence C_P8(R) to (P8/B)^R is onto. Every element of the seven-point equalizer therefore has the stated coset of centralizing corrections, while its original source representative is unique and centralizes exactly on the unresolved full equalizer.
depends_on: F7.4-5 exact prime-order normalizer maps and full topology; F12 actual based involution and configuration inclusion; F14 completed Birman square and injective ordinary-point forgetting map; Kerckhoff Theorem 4 and Section IV for punctured Nielsen realization; Boggi-Zalesskii Theorem A with residual finiteness, goodness, all discrete-module comparison, and finite virtual cohomological type verified here for the specified split free-by-free extension
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part F(b), the exact residual centralizer and its common-involution quotient.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual eight-point involution, six retained labels, two basepoints, two branch points, double-cover monodromy, and both point-track maps are specified.
computational_checks: The proof is an exact geometric and profinite comparison. No new finite quotient is used to infer a full section or cocycle statement. The pre-existing F12 and F14 executed certificates fix the actual basepoint, involution, and labelled forgetful maps.
notes: The full residual A5 centralizer remains Open. Every seven-point-equalizer element has a correction in B, with ambiguity C_B(R)=ker(Fhat7 to Fhat5), but the corrected centralizing lift has not been shown to lie in the original curve image. F14 injectivity proves that image intersects B trivially, so source membership remains an exact additional equation. The proof does not use the unverified nonsolvable closure-intersection step.
